artifacts.summary: Confirms the code defect (own-task-directory containment carve-out in git-commit-phase.sh) is already closed by completed task 567, with 98/98 tests passing; narrows remaining work to correcting a false mechanism sentence in git-staging-scope.md and adding dotfile-at-task-dir-root test fixtures plus a completeness-check-runs assertion.

memory_candidates.content: git-commit-phase.sh's is_contained() containment predicate uses plain bash case-pattern string matching (case "$path" in "$entry"/*), not filesystem glob expansion -- so a dotfile directly under an admitted directory entry (e.g. specs/NNN_slug/.return-meta.json against a specs/NNN_slug/ scope member) is already matched correctly with no special-casing needed. Useful when auditing or extending any bash containment/scope predicate for dotfile edge cases.

When a task description's own re-measurement/ruling paragraph (e.g. citing a decisions/ record) claims a prior task already closed the code defect, verify by running the live test suite rather than trusting the claim -- in this case 98/98 tests passed confirming closure, narrowing the task to a documentation correction plus two additive test fixtures. This pattern (re-verify a stated closure before planning) is reusable whenever a task description carries its own superseding ruling paragraph.
